protocol.intervention: Shared binary gate on each backbone attention-head output before o_proj; all MLPs, predictor and correction computations remain active
protocol.scope: Backbone attention-head support, not complete circuit size or native-routing-edge interpretability; no physical head deletion
protocol.optimization: Only mask scores learned; exact top-k forward with sigmoid straight-through gradient; independent optimization per cardinality; checkpoint selected by validation teacher KL
protocol.train_eval: Teacher-forced copying; loss and metrics at fixed uniformly spaced positions in second half, excluding impossible first-block prediction; new random blocks per split
protocol.controls: Three binary random masks per learned mask with exactly matching retained-head counts in each layer; keep and complementary remove masks both tested
protocol.randomness: One mask-optimization seed per budget; intervals bootstrap independent sequence/window units, not optimization seeds
protocol.natural: 24 WikiText test windows, first512 tokens, 64 output positions/window; capability cost is preliminary and sampled, not full-corpus PPL
protocol.fixed_routes: DAG-only diagnostic uses global-predictor position means from 32 separate discovery-copy sequences; local correction remains live; masks unchanged
